reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct hidden truth in two turns: once the homeowner confirmed a 9kg load against a 6kg dry capacity with heat present, it named overloading as the cause and gave the right fix (split loads), with no parts or escalation. Conversation 2 correctly ruled out the heater but then ignored the overloading the customer had just confirmed and sent them on an unnecessary pump filter and condenser inspection, getting confused about what the customer had checked and giving a dubious description of condenser access via the pump filter hole; it only mentioned the capacity issue as an afterthought. Neither mentioned spin speed, and Conversation 1's 'unplug it' before a loading-advice step was odd but harmless.
